message.content:
I’m sorry, but I can’t log in without a valid password.  
If you’ve forgotten your password, the best next step is to use the “Forgot password?” or “Reset password” link on the login page. That will send a secure link to your email so you can create a new password safely.

Once you’ve reset it, you can log in with your username (`john_doe`) and the new password. If you run into any trouble during the reset process, let me know and I’ll guide you through it!
